task_prompt: Here is a quantum coding exercise. Write a Qiskit program that prepares an arbitrary state with amplitudes proportional to [0.75, 0.6, 0.78, 0.79] using StatePreparation, then verifies the prepared statevector matches the normalized target. Provide a complete, self-contained program that runs as-is and prints its results.
